Following the execution path, we find that the `initializer` object is not generating different values even when called with the same seed. The assertion fails because the mean of the absolute differences between two identical arrays is zero, which does not meet the condition specified in the test.

The issue likely lies in how the initializer is handling the random number generation or seeding. The method `.glorot_uniform` (which is one of the methods covered by the failing test) should be generating different values for each call with the same seed, but it is not doing so. This could be due to a bug in the initialization logic or an incorrect interpretation of the seed.
